name: Multi-Step Python Script Workflow
description: A workflow that demonstrates multi-step Python code execution with data passing between steps. Creates a dataset, processes it, analyzes it, and generates a report.
context_rules: All files are created in /tmp/decisions_test/. Clean up when done.

steps.name: Generate sample data
steps.description: Create a CSV file with sample data
steps.instruction: Create a directory /tmp/decisions_test if it doesn't exist. Then create a CSV file at /tmp/decisions_test/data.csv with 20 rows of sample sales data. Each row should have: date (last 20 days), product (randomly chosen from 'Widget A', 'Widget B', 'Gadget C'), amount (random number between 10 and 500), and region (randomly chosen from 'North', 'South', 'East', 'West'). Print the first 5 rows and total count.

steps.name: Analyze data
steps.description: Process the CSV and compute statistics
steps.instruction: Read /tmp/decisions_test/data.csv and compute the following statistics: total sales amount, average amount per sale, number of sales by region, and the top-selling product. Print the results as a formatted summary. Save the analysis to /tmp/decisions_test/analysis.json.

steps.name: Generate report
steps.description: Create a human-readable report from the analysis
steps.instruction: Read /tmp/decisions_test/analysis.json and create a formatted text report at /tmp/decisions_test/report.txt. The report should have a title 'Sales Analysis Report', the date generated, and sections for each statistic from the analysis. Print the report content.
